title: ShadowTix
summary: An event ticketing platform built on Tari Ootle. ShadowTix provides a public event catalogue, on-chain ticket purchases, QR-based door check-in, refunds, and a capped resale market. Independent community-built project — not production-ready.
cardSummary: Explore on-chain event tickets, QR check-in, refunds and capped resale on Tari Ootle.
reviewNote: November 19, 2026: the current creator README still identifies Esmeralda testnet. Server-side extraction of the public app returned no text, so this source review does not establish current app availability or a mainnet deployment.
